title: Reservation Capacity Commitment Scope
purpose: Define which historically recorded held reservation commitments belong to the v1 commitment scope of an exact capacity stream once FOOD-007O has established that stream's governing capacity-source revision.

classification.name: cumulative-through-governing-revision
classification.rule: For one exact capacity stream governed at revision R, a recorded held commitment belongs to v1 scope when it is recorded against the same exact stream and its capacity revision is less than or equal to R.

governingPrerequisite.rule: FOOD-007P may derive commitment scope only from a successful FOOD-007O governing-source evaluation. A FOOD-007O invalid or does-not-match-policy result does not produce a v1 commitment scope.

skuStreamIdentity.rule: SKU commitment carry-forward occurs only within the same exact SKU id/version stream.

slotStreamIdentity.rule: Fulfillment-slot commitment carry-forward occurs only within the same exact method/locationReference/windowReference stream.

scopeBoundary.included: Recorded held commitments for the same exact stream whose capacityRevision is less than or equal to the governing revision.
scopeBoundary.excluded: Recorded commitments belonging to any different exact stream or to a capacity revision greater than the governing revision.

historicalRevisionBinding: A held reservation remains historically attributed to the exact capacity-source revision against which it was recorded. FOOD-007P does not rewrite, migrate, relabel, or replace that historical revision binding.
carryForwardPolicy: When a later capacity-source revision becomes governing for the same exact stream, earlier recorded held commitments remain in v1 commitment scope. Appending a later capacity assertion does not by itself release or erase prior held commitments.
capacityRevisionMeaning: For v1 commitment-scope purposes, later revisions of one exact capacity stream are successive capacity assertions for that stream, not independent reservable pools.
noImplicitReset: v1 defines no reset, supersession break, or commitment-forgetting operation inside one exact stream. If a future business rule requires a capacity-pool reset while preserving the same stream identity, that requires a new explicit durable contract before changing this policy.
skuAndSlotSymmetry: v1 applies the same through-governing-revision commitment-scope rule to exact SKU capacity streams and exact fulfillment-slot capacity streams.

sameCapacity.scopeStatement: The revision-1 held quantity remains in scope under governing revision 2.

downwardCapacityChange.scopeStatement: The revision-1 held quantity remains in scope. Later arithmetic may therefore produce a negative recorded delta and must not clamp it.

upwardCapacityChange.scopeStatement: The revision-1 held quantity remains in scope; the larger capacity assertion does not erase the earlier commitment.

plannedInput: The same outer commandInput plus observations structure accepted by FOOD-007O. FOOD-007P internally re-evaluates FOOD-007O and requires matches-policy.

plannedOutput.governing: The successful detached FOOD-007O governing-source evaluation.
plannedOutput.skuScopes: Canonical command-order exact SKU streams with each stream's governingRevision.
plannedOutput.slotScope: The canonical exact fulfillment-slot stream with its governingRevision.

futureReaderRule: A future durable recorded-held commitment reader may aggregate rows for the same exact stream where capacity_revision <= governingRevision. FOOD-007P itself performs no database read and no quantity aggregation.
food007jRelationship: FOOD-007J remains an exact-revision historical recorded-held commitment reader. FOOD-007P does not change FOOD-007J semantics and does not reinterpret a FOOD-007J result as cumulative.
food007kRelationship: FOOD-007K remains resolution of exact-revision recorded-held commitments for a reservation selection. It is historical exact-selection evidence, not the new governing cumulative scope.
food007lRelationship: FOOD-007L arithmetic remains exact to the recorded-held evidence supplied to it. FOOD-007P does not silently change FOOD-007L arithmetic inputs.
food007mRelationship: FOOD-007M remains demand-adjusted recorded-capacity arithmetic and is not a dependency of FOOD-007P.
mutationTimeBoundary: A previously derived commitment scope is not mutation authority. A future authoritative reservation writer must re-establish governing source state and read the applicable commitment scope inside the mutation boundary.
lifecycleBoundary: v1 scope is defined over durable rows recorded in held state under the current schema. FOOD-007P does not define release, expiration, cancellation, replacement, consumption, rescheduling, or future active-state semantics.
quantityBoundary: FOOD-007P does not read, sum, subtract, compare, clamp, or interpret capacityUnits, recordedHeldQuantity, reservation demand quantity, or any capacity delta.
authorityBoundary: FOOD-007P is a pure structural policy. It does not establish capacity sufficiency, admission, permission to reserve, remaining capacity, available capacity, reservable quantity, ATP, reservation acceptance, durable mutation success, or oversell prevention.
physicalTruthBoundary: FOOD-007P does not establish physical currentness, current physical QOH, fresh physical count, physical truth, sellable stock, or availability.
trustBoundary: FOOD-007P does not authenticate caller identity, observation provenance, database origin, sourceReference, attribution, observation age, or simultaneous snapshot acquisition.
sideEffects: None. The planned FOOD-007P domain function is pure and synchronous with no database, SQL, filesystem, network, clock, randomness, environment, or mutation behavior.
